info.name: Biggest client's share
info.definition: The share of the fee earned in the period that the biggest client earned us: the basis is fee earned (as F8 and F9), with the cash share -- the biggest payer's share of what was collected -- in the tooltip.
info.formula: biggest client's fee earned ÷ fee earned
info.source: Fees, retainers terms, time entries; payments for the cash share

info.name: Top three clients' share

info.formula: top three clients' fee earned ÷ fee earned

kpis.label: Revenue at risk

info.name: Revenue at risk
info.definition: The monthly fee of retainers past their renewal date with no renewal deal, ending within the next 60 days with no renewal deal, or being renegotiated with no renewal deal. Any one with an open renewal deal is in renewal, listed beside them and left out of this total.
info.formula: Σ monthly fee of those retainers
info.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

kpis.sub: With no renewal deal: renegotiating, ending in 60 days or past their date

quiet.title: Going quiet
quiet.subtitle: Active clients with no new task, approval or invoice in 30 days

info.name: Going quiet
info.definition: Active clients with no new task, no task approved and no invoice for the number of days in Settings. A client whose every retainer has ended is not quiet: they are lost, and counted there.
info.formula: count of Active clients with nothing in N days
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

lost.title: Lost in the last six months
lost.subtitle: Retainers that ended to 31 Oct 2026

info.name: Lost
info.definition: Retainers that ended in the six months to the end of the period, with their reasons. One past its renewal date with nothing decided is not lost yet: it stays under renewals until somebody marks it.
info.formula: count of retainers ended in six months
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

paid.label: Days sales outstanding

info.name: Days sales outstanding
info.definition: How many days of invoicing are still unpaid: the balance open at the end of the period against what was invoiced in the 90 days to it.
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

paid.sub: Receivables at the end of Oct 2026 against 90 days of invoicing

paid.label: Collection rate

info.name: Collection rate
info.definition: Money received in the period against what fell due in it.
info.formula: collected ÷ invoices due in the period
